catalog.title: Temporary email failure retries without rolling back Bug workflow
catalog.testData: Use controlled SAP BTP QA data; do not use production or private personal data.
catalog.expectedResult: Bug workflow remains committed; delivery records a bounded retry/failure state without duplicate business history.
catalog.postcondition: Keep controlled QA data unless the case explicitly tests deletion.
catalog.environment: SAP BTP AppRouter + XSUAA + SAP HANA Cloud; external provider checks only where stated.
evidenceRequirements: sanitized case manifest with role, timestamp, baseline/deploy SHA, expected and actual result

execution.actualResult: BLOCKED before execution: the approved scope does not provide an authorized isolated per-delivery provider-failure mechanism or a local full Bug workflow harness that can prove the Bug commit, retry/failure state, reload readback, and absence of duplicate business history together.

governance.boundary: No raw email/provider body or ID, lock/lease/idempotency value, identity hash, token/JWT, credential, endpoint, binding/env/log control, arbitrary audit export, outage simulation, schema/index change, or live provider/data mutation.
governance.finding: Existing local email tests use an isolated SQLite/in-memory setup and exercise email/outbox functions, but they do not invoke a real Bug workflow or prove the complete UAT assertion that no duplicate business history is created.
governance.missingPrecondition: An approved isolated per-delivery failure mechanism or a local full Bug workflow harness with case-specific runtime-equivalent readback.
governance.requiredNextEvidence: Official UAT must capture case-specific runtime evidence for the workflow action, bounded retry/failure state, Bug reload/readback, and duplicate-history check after the missing precondition is approved and available.
